nom: StriVectin Peptide Plump Collagen Renewal Eye Masks

concerns.aging: Reviewers consistently report the masks soften the look of fine lines and crow's feet with regular use, though several say results are subtle after a single use and take repeated applications to build.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the hydrogel formula leaves the under-eye area visibly more hydrated and refreshed immediately after removal, an effect several describe as most noticeable right after use.

aspects.libelle: Non-slip, stays in place during wear

extraits.texte: It's extremely sticky and hard to remove it pulls at the delicate under eye skin. Paired with it seemingly making no difference to the dark appearance. Will not buy again.

I love adding eye masks to my morning routine for puffiness, hydrating, and a little extra help with fine lines and dark circles (though I am sure what I have is genetic - I've had dark circles since I was 13!). After trying these, I did notice a slight improvement in fine lines, even after 2 uses. I can also tell that there's a few ingredients that may be coconut derived, as there was mild irritation both times. Overall, they deliver a nice hydration and refreshing gel, but if you're sensitive to coconut-based ingredients, proceed with caution.

The product itself is high quality - felt-lined backing eye patches that adhere snuggly when placed underneath the eyes. A trial period usage for more than 3-weeks yielded a significant decrease in puffiness of both eyes, but did little to nothing for lightening and/or reducing the appearance of dark circles. I'm excited to see what results are yielded from long-term use for lightening the under eye dark circles.

extraits.titre: StriVectin Peptide Plump Collagen Renewal Eye Mask
extraits.texte: I'm absolutely thrilled with the StriVectin Peptide Plump Collagen Renewal Eye Masks! As someone who's struggled with dark circles, crow's feet, and wrinkles, I was skeptical at first, but these little gems have genuinely impressed me. The packaging is sleek and modern, with a touch of elegance that makes you feel like you're treating yourself to a spa experience. The box contains 6 pairs of non-slip, cooling hydrogel masks that are designed to target those pesky under-eye concerns. What I love most about these masks is how easy they are to use. Simply place them under your eyes, relax for a bit, and voilà! Your skin will thank you. The collagen renewal formula works wonders in plumping up fine lines and wrinkles, leaving your under-eye area looking smoother and more radiant. I've noticed a significant reduction in dark circles and crow's feet since incorporating these masks into my skincare routine. My skin looks more refreshed, and I feel like I've got a newfound confidence. If you're struggling with under-eye concerns like I was, give these masks a try. Trust me, you won't regret it!

These eye masks are fantastic. They feel cool and refreshing as soon as you put them on, and they stay in place without slipping. After just 10 minutes, my under-eye area looks smoother and more awake. I noticed a visible difference in the appearance of fine lines and puffiness. I also appreciate the powerhouse ingredients like Microalgae Peptides for hydration, Alpha-3 Peptide to help reduce wrinkles, and Marine Ferment to depuff and smooth the skin. They're fragrance free, ophthalmologist tested, and gentle enough to use multiple times a week.

I'm not even going to lie. I wanted to try these thanks to the hereditary dark undereye situation, which requires a daily battle! Apply and wait 10 minutes to remove and see ... a glistening undereye. I mean, yay? Is it the glisten that's supposed to lessen the darkness? 6 pairs come in the box - it looks like for the next work week, I'll see how it plays out ...

reserve: The reviews rarely state the reviewer's skin type, so segmentation by oily, dry, combination, sensitive, normal, or mature skin could not be produced for this product.
